        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end2</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>endA1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="sp1" name="Process new defaulting accounts">

      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="g3" name="Client codes previously advised?" />
      <bpmn:task id="produce" name="Produce another table of defaulting accounts" />
      <bpmn:task id="send" name="Send the table to account management" />
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="m1" />
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="m2" />
      <bpmn:endEvent id="e1" name="First part completed" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="a1" sourceRef="s1" targetRef="backup" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="a2" sourceRef="backup" targetRef="checkTable" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="a3" sourceRef="checkTable" targetRef="g1" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="a4" name="yes" sourceRef="g1" targetRef="m2" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="a5" name="no" sourceRef="g1" targetRef="crm1" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="a6" sourceRef="crm1" targetRef="g2" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="a7" name="no" sourceRef="g2" targetRef="m2" />

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="a10" name="no" sourceRef="g3" targetRef="produce" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="a11" name="yes" sourceRef="g3" targetRef="m1" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="a12" sourceRef="produce" targetRef="send" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="a13" sourceRef="send" targetRef="m1" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="a14" sourceRef="m1" targetRef="m2" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="a15" sourceRef="m2" targetRef="e1" />
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="t1" name="2:30 pm" cancelActivity="false" attachedToRef="sp1">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition><bpmn:timeDate>14:30</bpmn:timeDate></bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="alert1" name="Send an alert to the supervisor" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endA1" name="Supervisor alerted" />
    <bpmn:subProcess id="sp2" name="Reconcile new returns">

      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="h1" name="New returns filed?" />
      <bpmn:task id="reconcile" name="Reconcile with the existing account defaulters table" />
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="hm" />
      <bpmn:endEvent id="e2" name="Second part completed" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="b1" sourceRef="s2" targetRef="crm2" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="b2" sourceRef="crm2" targetRef="h1" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="b3" name="yes" sourceRef="h1" targetRef="reconcile" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="b4" name="no" sourceRef="h1" targetRef="hm" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="b5" sourceRef="reconcile" targetRef="hm" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="b6" sourceRef="hm" targetRef="e2" />
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="t2" name="4:00 pm" cancelActivity="false" attachedToRef="sp2">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition><bpmn:timeDate>16:00</bpmn:timeDate></bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="alert2" name="Send a message to the supervisor" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endA2" name="Supervisor messaged" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="done" name="Process completed" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end1" name="Unused" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end2" name="Unused 2" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="sp1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="sp1" targetRef="sp2" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="sp2" targetRef="done" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="t1" targetRef="alert1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="alert1" targetRef="endA1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="t2" targetRef="alert2" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="alert2" targetRef="endA2" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
